.field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;

.field label {
  margin-bottom: 6px;

  font-size: 14px;

.wpcf7 input,

  outline: none;
  transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;

.wpcf7 input:focus,
.wpcf7 select:focus,
.wpcf7 textarea:focus {
  border-color: #002b8e;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 43, 142, 0.12);

.wpcf7 textarea {
  min-height: 140px;

  font-weight: bold;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.2s ease;
  width: 100%;
}

.wpcf7 input[type="submit"]:hover {
  background: #001f66;
}

.wpcf7-not-valid-tip {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #d93025;
  margin-top: 4px;

html { overflow-x: hidden; }

/* CONTAINER */
.form-container {
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 32px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
  background: #fff;
}

/* TÍTULOS */
.form-container h1 {
  color: #002b8e;
  font-size: 32px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.form-container p {
  color: #555;
  font-size: 16px;
}

/* GRID */
/* .row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 16px;
} */

.row-3 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 2fr 80px 2fr;
  gap: 16px;
}

/* CAMPOS */
.field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

/* LABEL */
.field label {
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #002b8e;
  font-size: 14px;
}

/* INPUTS DO CF7 */
.wpcf7 input,
.wpcf7 select,
.wpcf7 textarea {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid #cfd7ea;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 15px;
  outline: none;
  transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

/* FOCO */
.wpcf7 input:focus,
.wpcf7 select:focus,
.wpcf7 textarea:focus {
  border-color: #002b8e;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 43, 142, 0.12);
}

/* TEXTAREA */
.wpcf7 textarea {
  min-height: 140px;
  resize: vertical;
}

/* BOTÃO */
.wpcf7 input[type="submit"] {
  background: #002b8e;
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  padding: 14px 20px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.2s ease;
  width: 100%;
}

.wpcf7 input[type="submit"]:hover {
  background: #001f66;
}

/* MENSAGENS DE ERRO */
.wpcf7-not-valid-tip {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #d93025;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

/* RESPOSTA DO FORM */
.wpcf7-response-output {
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding: 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

#taboola-below-article-thumbnails,
#taboola-below-article-thumbnails---home {
	max-width: 63.5rem;
	margin: 0 auto;
}

#taboola-below-article-thumbnails---home {
	overflow-x: hidden;
}

.embla__slide--ad .ad-placeholder {

.bwgr-n5 > .bwgr-n5__inner {
	padding: 16px 24px !important;
}

.bwgr-n5__header {
	margin-bottom: 16px !important;
}

.ad-position.ad-position--above-header.floater { height: 0; }

}

<style id="wp-custom-css">
html { overflow-x: hidden; }

/* CONTAINER */
.form-container {
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 32px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
  background: #fff;
}

/* TÍTULOS */
.form-container h1 {
  color: #002b8e;
  font-size: 32px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.form-container p {
  color: #555;
  font-size: 16px;
}

/* GRID */
/* .row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 16px;
} */

.row-3 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 2fr 80px 2fr;
  gap: 16px;
}

/* CAMPOS */
.field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

/* LABEL */
.field label {
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #002b8e;
  font-size: 14px;
}

/* INPUTS DO CF7 */
.wpcf7 input,
.wpcf7 select,
.wpcf7 textarea {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid #cfd7ea;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 15px;
  outline: none;
  transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

/* FOCO */
.wpcf7 input:focus,
.wpcf7 select:focus,
.wpcf7 textarea:focus {
  border-color: #002b8e;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 43, 142, 0.12);
}

/* TEXTAREA */
.wpcf7 textarea {
  min-height: 140px;
  resize: vertical;
}

/* BOTÃO */
.wpcf7 input[type="submit"] {
  background: #002b8e;
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  padding: 14px 20px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.2s ease;
  width: 100%;
}

.wpcf7 input[type="submit"]:hover {
  background: #001f66;
}

/* MENSAGENS DE ERRO */
.wpcf7-not-valid-tip {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #d93025;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

/* RESPOSTA DO FORM */
.wpcf7-response-output {
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding: 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

/* TABOOLA */
#taboola-below-article-thumbnails,
#taboola-below-article-thumbnails---home {
	max-width: 63.5rem;
	margin: 0 auto;
}

#taboola-below-article-thumbnails---home {
	overflow-x: hidden;
}

/* Taboola Gallery */

.embla__slide--ad .ad-placeholder {
	display: block!important;
}

/* Sessão Colunistas Capa */
.bwgr-n5 > .bwgr-n5__inner {
	padding: 16px 24px !important;
}

.bwgr-n5__header {
	margin-bottom: 16px !important;
}

.ad-position.ad-position--above-header.floater { height: 0; }

#div-gpt-ad-diariolitoral__conteudo__regular__floater__display__1,
#div-gpt-ad-diariolitoral__conteudo__regular__floater__display__2 {
	height:0px;
}

#div-gpt-ad-diariolitoral__conteudo__regular__in_image__display__1 {
	overflow: hidden;
  max-height: 50px;
}


div.wp-block-query.saiba-mais .wp-block-post-date {
	display:none;
}

/* RESPONSIVO */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .row,
  .row-3 {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .form-container {
    padding: 24px;
  }
	
	
	/* ADS */
	.ad-position--below-header {
		background-color: var(--wp--preset--color--neutral-200);
    margin-top: 0 !important;
	}
	
	.ad-position div[id^=div-gpt-ad-], .article-content div[id^=div-gpt-ad-] {
		background-color: var(--wp--preset--color--neutral-200);
	}
	
  .article-content div[id^=div-gpt-ad-],
	.billboard div[id^=div-gpt-ad-],
	.billboard_bottom div[id^=div-gpt-ad-],
	.billboard_top div[id^=div-gpt-ad-] {
    min-height: 130px !important;
  }
	
	.ad-position.flying-carpet,
	.bwgr-n2__author,
	.bwgr-n2 .list__card-meta--details {
		display:none;
		visibility:hidden;
	}
	
	.bwgr-n1__image {
    height: 230px!important;
  }
	
	.bwgr-n1__image {
    object-fit: contain !important;
  }
	
	.article-content div[id^=div-gpt-ad-], .billboard div[id^=div-gpt-ad-], .billboard_bottom div[id^=div-gpt-ad-], .billboard_top div[id^=div-gpt-ad-] {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
    }

.ad-position--pleito-news-between-posts,

}

  .eleicoes.hide-on-desktop {
    display: none;
  }
}

	height:0px;
}
